name: Impact vs. Effort Matrix
deliverable: 2x2 prioritization of quick wins, major projects, and time sinks

steps.text: Draw two axes: impact on the north-star metric upward, delivery effort rightward. Define what each end means.
Choose one agreed baseline item, then place each card by comparing it with the baseline on impact first.
Shift each card horizontally by real effort: build, coordination, review, and risk, not coding hours alone.
Push every card off the center line so no item hides in an ambiguous middle position.
Read the quadrants aloud and name the action each one authorizes: sprint, spike, backlog, or drop.

failure: Effort optimism and pet-feature impact inflate every card, so the grid crowds into one corner and ranks nothing.
intervention: Ask what the item costs beyond coding, compare it with a known small change, and force the top three impact cards into a strict order.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in product prioritization; no single documented originator.
